F30.equation: WCD(F30) = Σ_h [ B_total(h) / (IdleSlope - Σ_r(h)) + T_CBS(h) + (t_prop + t_switch + t_sync) ]

WCD_calculation.arrival_curves: alpha_f(t) = b_f + r_f * t, with b_f = 8*Payload_bits and r_f = 8*Payload_bytes / Period_us (Mbps).
WCD_calculation.per_port_service_curve: beta_port(t) = [IdleSlope * (t - T_CBS(port))]^+, with IdleSlope = 75 Mbps and T_CBS(port) = (Lmax*8/C) * (C - IdleSlope)/IdleSlope.
WCD_calculation.per_hop_delay_bound: For affine arrivals and CBS rate-latency server: D_hop = (B_total_port) / (IdleSlope - Σ_r_port) + T_CBS + t_prop + t_switch + t_sync.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end: WCD(flow) = sum over all egress ports on its path of D_hop.

missing_inputs: Exact Ethernet frame size on the wire (preamble, SFD, MAC header, VLAN tag, FCS, IFG). Assumed payload bytes equal on-the-wire frame size.
Presence/absence of any other traffic classes (BE, control) on the same ports. Assumed none besides AVB Class A.
Exact 802.1Qav credit scaling and hiCredit/loCredit computation under mixed priorities. Assumed hiCredit = 0 and loCredit bit-equivalent = -2*Lmax_bytes on each port (no higher-priority blocking).
Propagation of burstiness through successive CBS servers. Not applied; used per-hop blind multiplexing with original bursts for all flows.
Application of time synchronization error. Assumed +1 µs per hop as a conservative constant.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_i(t) = b_i + r_i * t, with b_i = L_i_bits and r_i = L_i_bits / period_i_sec
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = R * [ t - T_p ]^+, with T_p = L_block/C + |Vmin|/I = (1 + (C - I)/I) * L_block/C = (4/3) * L_block/C. Numerically, T_p_us = L_block_bits / 75.
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_port = T_p + b_agg / (R - r_agg)
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD_equation: WCD(flow) = sum_over_egress_ports_on_path( D_port ) + hop_count * (switching_delay_us + propagation_delay_us) + time_synchronization_error_us

all_parameters_used.arrival_curves: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, with sigma_i = 8 * payload_i (bits), rho_i = (8 * payload_i) / period_us (Mb/s)
all_parameters_used.queueing_bound_equation: For port p: Dq_p = horizontal deviation h(sum_i alpha_i, beta_p) = (sum_i sigma_i) / (R - sum_i rho_i). With units simplification at 100 Mb/s and Mb/s: Dq_p_us = 8 * sumB_bytes / (R_Mbps - rho_total_Mbps)

WCD_calculation.equation: For flow i over its ordered egress ports p in path: WCD_i = sum_p [ T_cbs_p + (8 * sumB_p_bytes) / (R_Mbps - rho_total_p_Mbps) + 0.08 * payload_i_bytes + 2 ] + SyncError_us
notes: T_cbs_p models CBS credit latency with only Class A present: T_cbs_p = Lmax_p/C + (Lmax_p/C) * (C - R)/R, with C=100 Mb/s and R=75 Mb/s.
All AVB Class A frames are mapped to queue 6. No other traffic classes are assumed; hence no non-AVB blocking is modeled.
Queueing bound Dq_p is computed on aggregate arrivals (FIFO within the AVB-A queue) using Network Calculus horizontal deviation of a token-bucket sum and a rate-latency service curve.
Per-hop constant 2 us covers 1 us cut-through switching + 1 us propagation on that link.
Serialization per hop of the considered frame is added as 0.08 * payload_bytes (us at 100 Mb/s).
A single global time-synchronization uncertainty of 1 us is added per flow.

Thus V_hi = 0 (no lower-priority non-preemptive blocking), and latency term stems from credit recovery (V_lo).
Per-port L_A_max is taken as the maximum payload size of any Class-A flow traversing that egress port.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_f(t) = b_f + r_f t, with b_f = payload_bytes, r_f = payload_bytes / period_us
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_port(t) = R [t - T_cbs]^+ where R = IdleSlope (Bytes/us), T_cbs = |V_lo| / IdleSlope = (C - R)/(C*R) * L_A_max(port) = L_A_max(port) / 37.5 us (with C=12.5 B/us, R=9.375 B/us).
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_port = T_cbs + b_total / (R - r_total), with b_total and r_total the aggregates of all Class-A flows sharing that egress port.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_delay: D_flow = sum_over_egress_ports_on_path(D_port) + N_links * propagation_delay + N_switches * switching_delay + N_switches * time_sync_error

Precise accounting of time synchronization error (per-hop vs. end-to-end). Modeled as 1 us per switch.
Exact CBS parameterization (configured hiCredit/loCredit). Derived loCredit from L_A_max per port using standard Qav relationships.

CBS_service_curve_per_port.beta_p(t): R * [t - T]^+, with R = IdleSlope_B_per_us, T = switch(1us) + prop(1us) + sync(1us) + Lmax/C + (|SendSlope|/IdleSlope)*(Lmax/C)
notes: Non-preemptive blocking by Lmax on the port accounted via Lmax/C
Credit recovery latency accounted via (|SendSlope|/IdleSlope)*(Lmax/C) = (0.25/0.75)*(Lmax/C) = (1/3)*(Lmax/C)

WCD_calculation.per_flow_e2e: WCD(flow) = sum over all egress ports p on the flow's route of D_p

WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_p(f) = sigma_f / (IS - sum_{g in S_p} rho_g) + T_p + (sum_{g in S_p\{f}} sigma_g)/IS

all_parameters_used.CBS_credit_rules: credit increases at IdleSlope when not transmitting and backlog exists; decreases at (C - IdleSlope) when transmitting; transmit allowed only when credit >= 0
all_parameters_used.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, with sigma_i = 8*payload_i (bits), rho_i = sigma_i / period_i (bits/us)
all_parameters_used.per_hop_delay_formula: D_port = (Sigma_port_bits / R) + T0, with R = IdleSlope (bits/us) and Sigma_port_bits = sum of sigma over all flows on that egress port; T0 as above
all_parameters_used.end_to_end_WCD_formula: WCD(flow i) = sum over all egress ports p on i's path of D_port(p)

equations: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t
sigma_i = 8 * payload_i (bits)
rho_i = sigma_i / period_i (bits/us)
Per-port CBS service: beta_p(t) = R * max(0, t - T0_p)
R = IdleSlope = 0.75 * C = 75 bits/us
T0_p = switching_delay + propagation_delay + time_sync_error + (L_np_bits/C) + |loCredit|/I_s
With loCredit = - L_np_bits * (C - I_s)/C => |loCredit|/I_s = (L_np_bits/C) * (C - I_s)/I_s = (L_np_bits/C)/3
Thus T0_p = 3 us + (4/3) * (L_np_bits/C)
FIFO aggregate per-hop delay bound for any flow on port p: D_p = (Sigma_port_bits / R) + T0_p
End-to-end worst-case delay: WCD_i = sum over all egress ports p on the path of flow i of D_p

Whether non-preemptive blocking should consider frames from other priorities; we used max frame among the AVB flows sharing the port

Per-flow scheduling inside the AVB Class A queue (assumed FIFO multiplexing)

CBS.service_curve: beta_j(t) = R * [t - T_j]^+, with R=I=75 Mbps, T_j = (-loCredit_bits)/I = Lmax_bits * (c - I)/(c*I) = Lmax_bits/300 microseconds

all_parameters_used.per_port_aggregation: sigma_j = sum L_i_bits, rho_j = sum (L_i_bits/T_i_us) over flows sharing the egress

WCD_calculation.per_port_queueing: Dq_j = T_credit_j + sigma_j_bits / (R - rho_j), where T_credit_j = Lmax_j_bits * (c - I)/(c*I) = Lmax_bits/300 microseconds, R=75 (Mbps), rho_j in Mbps, sigma_j in bits
WCD_calculation.per_flow_e2e: WCD_i = (sum over egress ports j in path_i of Dq_j) + hop_count_i * PropDelay + num_switches_i * SwitchDelay + TimeSyncError

counts_definition.num_switches_i: Equals number of egress ports traversed by the flow (or hop_count_i - 1)

WCD_calculation.notes: All flows share only AVB Class A queue (PCP 6). No other classes considered; therefore hiCredit=0 and loCredit determined by the class-A max frame size on that port.

all_parameters_used.arrival_curve_model: Token-bucket for each flow: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i t with sigma_i = payload_bits, rho_i = payload_bits/period_us
all_parameters_used.service_curve_model: CBS lower-bounded rate-latency per port: beta_p(t) = R_p [t - T_p]^+ with R_p = IdleSlope; T_p = switching + propagation + sync = 3 us

leftover_service_under_arbitrary_multipl.residual_rate_R_i: R_i = R_p - sum_{j != i on port} rho_j
leftover_service_under_arbitrary_multipl.residual_latency_T_i: T_i = T_p + (sum_{j != i on port} sigma_j)/R_p

per_port_CBS_service_curve.definition: beta_p(t) = R_p * [t - T_p]^+ with R_p = IdleSlope and T_p = L_max_bits * (1/IdleSlope - 1/C)

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, where sigma_i = payload_bits, rho_i = payload_bits / period_seconds
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = R_p [t - T_p]^+ with R_p = IdleSlope, T_p = L_max_bits * (1/IdleSlope - 1/C)
WCD_calculation.leftover_service_curve_for_flow_i_on_por: beta_i_p(t) = (R_p - sum_{j!=i} rho_j) [t - (T_p + sum_{j!=i} sigma_j / R_p)]^+ (blind multiplexing)
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound_for_flow_i: D_{i,p} = sigma_i / (R_p - sum_{j!=i} rho_j) + T_p + (sum_{j!=i} sigma_j) / R_p, provided sum_j rho_j < R_p
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_delay_bound: WCD_i = sum_over_ports_on_path(D_{i,p}) + N_links * d_prop + N_switches * d_sw + d_sync

assumptions: All flows are AVB Class A with PCP=6 and map exclusively to queue 6 on every egress port.
Only CBS (Qav) is in effect; no TAS, no preemption.
No lower-priority traffic is provided; therefore L_BE_max is taken as 0 on every port (optimistic).
Cut-through switching; fixed 1 µs switching delay per switch egress hop.
Applied 1 µs propagation per link.
Applied 1 µs time-sync error per switch hop as a conservative guard band even though CBS does not use gates.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = b_f + r_f * t, with r_f = payload_B / period_us, b_f = payload_B
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta(t) >= [ I * (t - T_CBS) ]^+, where I = IdleSlope and T_CBS = Vmax / I with Vmax = (I/C)*L_BE_max + (C - I)/C * L_A_max; equivalently T_CBS = L_BE_max/C + L_A_max * (1/I - 1/C)
WCD_calculation.leftover_service_for_flow_f_on_port: R' = I - r_A, T' = T_CBS + b_A / (I - r_A), where r_A and b_A are the aggregate rate and burst of all other flows sharing that egress port
WCD_calculation.per_port_WCD_for_flow_f: D_hop = T' + b_f / (R' - r_f), valid if r_f < R' (satisfied here)
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_switch_egresses(D_hop) + N_switch_hops * switching_delay + N_links * propagation_delay + N_switch_hops * sync_error

missing_inputs: Maximum lower-priority frame size per port (L_BE_max) to bound non-preemptive blocking in hiCredit; assumed 0 B here (no lower-priority interference provided).
Whether end systems (nodes) also use CBS shaping; assumed no, only switches shape.
Exact treatment of time synchronization error for CBS (not gate-based); assumed 1 µs per switch hop as a guard.

CBS_service_curve_assumption.T_p_definition: T_p = L_block/C + Vmax/I; Vmax assumed 0 due to no specified lower-priority traffic

WCD_calculation.per_hop_leftover_service: For port p and flow f: beta_p(t) = I*[t - T_p]^+. Cross-traffic alpha_c(t) = sigma_c + rho_c t. Leftover beta_f,p(t) = [beta_p(t) - alpha_c(t)]_+ = (R' * [t - T'_p])^+ with R' = I - rho_c and T'_p = (I*T_p + sigma_c)/R'.
WCD_calculation.per_hop_delay: D_p(f) = T'_p + sigma_f / R', where sigma_f is the frame size in bits for f.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD(f) = sum_over_hops D_p(f) + hop_count(f)*prop_delay + num_switches(f)*switch_delay + time_sync_error.

missing_inputs: Whether end-stations (nodes) implement 802.1Qav CBS (assumed yes for source egress shaping).

Exact L2 overheads (preamble, IFG, headers, FCS). Payload bytes were treated as on-wire bits; adding L2 overhead would increase both blocking and serialization times.
Intra-queue scheduling policy (assumed FIFO for Class A).

WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD_for_flow_f: WCD_f = sum over egress ports p on f's path of D_port + 1us for source-to-first-switch propagation
notes: hiCredit = 0 on every port because only AVB Class A traffic exists; there is no lower-priority blocking to accumulate positive credit.
loCredit_p = -((C - I)/C) * Lmax_p (credit in bits).
All ports run at 100 Mb/s; all CBS parameters identical across ports except Lmax_p which depends on the set of flows sharing that port.
All flows share queue 6 only; no higher-priority interference.

missing_inputs: Whether any background/non-AVB traffic exists (assumed none).
Exact Ethernet frame size on the wire (headers, preamble, IFG) — payload used as frame size here.
Per-node NIC shaping or queuing behavior at the source nodes (assumed none beyond CBS in switches).
Whether preemption (802.1Qbu) is enabled (assumed no preemption).

Clarification on whether to include source-NIC serialization; a 1us source-to-first-switch propagation was included, while service/serialization is conservatively covered by the RL server with R=IdleSlope.

queue_mapping.remark: All AVB Class A flows exclusively mapped to queue 6 on every egress port

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, with sigma_i = payload_i [B], rho_i = payload_i / period_i [B/us]
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = R * [t - T_p]^+, with R = IdleSlope (Bytes/us); T_p = L_max_p * (C - I) / (C * I) + t_switch + t_prop + t_sync
WCD_calculation.SendSlope: S = I - C (negative). Here S = -25 Mbps = -3.125 B/us

aggregate_params_at_port.rho_total: sum of rho_i of all flows using the port
aggregate_params_at_port.sigma_total_in: sum of sigma_i at ingress to the port (propagated per-flow: sigma_out = sigma_in + rho_i * T_p at previous hop)

WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_port = T_p + sigma_total_in / (R - rho_total), valid for R > rho_total
WCD_calculation.per_flow_sigma_propagation: At each hop: sigma_i_out = sigma_i_in + rho_i * T_p (min-plus deconvolution for rate-latency server)
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_delay: WCD(flow k) = 1us (source-to-first-switch propagation) + sum over ports on path(k) of D_port

missing_inputs: Exact treatment of Time Synchronization error (per hop vs end-to-end): assumed 1us per switch egress hop inside T_p

assumptions: Only the given flows exist on the network; no other classes or BE traffic present.
CBS is the only shaping/scheduling mechanism; all traffic maps to queue 6.
Frame size equals given payload size; no L2 headers or preamble/SFD/IFG overheads added.
End stations are treated as periodic sources without CBS shaping; CBS applies at switch egress ports.
Per-hop fixed delays add 1 µs switching (per switch) and 1 µs propagation (per link).

WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: For each egress port p with CBS(IdleSlope=I), lower-bounded service curve is beta_p(t) = I * [t - T_p]^+, with T_p = L_max_p / I, where L_max_p is the maximum same-queue frame size on port p.
WCD_calculation.leftover_service_to_flow: Under arbitrary multiplexing, leftover rate-latency service to flow i at port p: R_i' = I - sum_{j!=i} r_j, T_i' = T_p + (sum_{j!=i} b_j)/I.
WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: Each periodic flow i with period P_i and payload L_i has alpha_i(t) = r_i * t + b_i, with r_i = 8*L_i / P_i, b_i = 8*L_i. Time sync error J adds jitter: effective b_i := b_i + r_i * J.
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay: d_i,p = b_i_eff / (R_i' - r_i) + T_i'. Units: bits/(bits/us) gives us, T_i' in us.
WCD_calculation.fixed_delays: Per switch: +1 us switching. Per link: +1 us propagation. Total fixed = N_switches*1us + N_links*1us, where N_links equals the provided hop_count for the route.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_i = sum over egress ports p along i's path of d_i,p + N_switches_i*1us + N_links_i*1us.

missing_inputs: Exact L2 overheads (MAC header, VLAN tag, preamble/SFD, IFG) to convert payload size to on-the-wire bits.
Whether sources (end stations) apply CBS; analysis assumed CBS only at switch egress.
Exact CBS hiCredit/loCredit derivation considering other priority classes (we assumed only Class A exists).
Any guard bands or frame preemption usage (802.1Qbu/802.3br) not specified; assumed none.

all_parameters_used.arrival_curve_model: alpha_i(t) = b_i + r_i * t with b_i = L_i_bits, r_i = L_i_bits / period_i_us
all_parameters_used.queueing_delay_model: Dq_port = b_total / (I - r_total) for FIFO aggregate at queue 6

equations: SendSlope S = IdleSlope I - LinkRate C
Per-flow arrival curve: r_i = L_i_bits / P_i_us, b_i = L_i_bits
Aggregate arrival at port: r_total = sum(r_i over flows using the egress), b_total = sum(b_i)
CBS service curve: beta(t) = I * (t - T_cbs)^+, with T_cbs = ((C - I)/(C*I)) * L_A_max_bits = L_A_max_bits / 300
Per-port worst-case delay: D_port = b_total / (I - r_total) + T_cbs + d_sw + d_prop + J_sync
End-to-end WCD(flow) = sum over all egress ports on the path of D_port

variable_definitions.L_i_bits: flow i frame size in bits (payload_bytes * 8)
variable_definitions.L_A_max_bits: maximum Class A frame size among flows sharing the port
variable_definitions.J_sync: time synchronization error per hop (1 us)

notes: All flows are AVB Class A (PCP=6) and use queue 6 exclusively.
No other traffic classes are modeled; hiCredit = 0 due to absence of lower-priority blocking.
FIFO within Class A queue implicitly assumed for aggregate burst model.

missing_inputs: Exact on-wire Ethernet frame sizes (headers, VLAN tag, preamble/SFD, IFG) not provided; assumed frame size equals payload bytes.
Whether time synchronization error should be accounted once per path or per hop; modeled here as +1 us per hop.
Potential non-AVB/background traffic not specified; assumed none.

equations.arrival_curve: alpha_i(t) = b_i + r_i * t, with b_i = L_i (bits), r_i = L_i / T_i (bits/us)
equations.port_service_curve: For each port p (CBS), beta_p(t) = R * [t - T_p]^+, with R = IdleSlope * C = 0.75 * 100 bits/us = 75 bits/us, T_p = L_max_p / R
equations.leftover_service_curve: For flow i on port p with cross-traffic C: beta_i,p(t) = (R - r_c) * [t - (T_p + B_c / R)]^+, where r_c = sum_j r_j over j in C, B_c = sum_j b_j over j in C
equations.per_port_delay: D_i,p = b_i / (R - r_c - r_i) + T_p + B_c / R  (equivalently D_i,p = b_i / (R - r_total) + T_p + B_c / R, with r_total = r_i + r_c)

equations.beta_port: beta_p(t) = R [t - T_p]^+, with T_p = L_max_p / R
equations.end_to_end: WCD_i = sum_p D_i,p + N_links*prop + N_switches*switch + time_sync_error

all_parameters_used.shaper: Credit-Based Shaper (IEEE 802.1Qav), single AVB Class A (PCP=6) queue per egress port

CBS_credits.HiCredit_formula: HiCredit = I * L_block / C; L_block assumed 0 (no lower-priority traffic) => HiCredit = 0

all_parameters_used.service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = I * (t - T_p)+, with T_p = L_block/C + |LoCredit|/I. With L_block=0 => T_p = (0.25 * L_A_max)/I = L_A_max/37.5 (us).
all_parameters_used.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, with sigma_i = L_i (Bytes), rho_i = L_i / P_i (B/us).
all_parameters_used.per_port_delay_bound: D_p = (sum_i sigma_i) / (I - sum_i rho_i) + T_p (us), for all flows i sharing port p (FIFO within queue)
all_parameters_used.end_to_end_WCD: WCD(flow j) = sum_over_ports_on_path_j D_p + (#links on path)*prop_delay + (#switches on path)*switch_delay

WCD_calculation.equation_used: For each egress port p on the flow path: D_p = (Σ sigma_i)/(I - Σ rho_i) + T_p, with I = 9.375 B/us, T_p = L_A_max/37.5 us. Then WCD_j = Σ_p D_p + H*1us + S*1us, where H=#links, S=#switches.
notes: All flows are Class A (PCP=6) using the same CBS queue 6 at each egress port.
No lower-priority traffic was provided; therefore L_block = 0 was assumed, yielding HiCredit=0 and T_p = |LoCredit|/I.
Frame size was taken as the provided payload size (Bytes), as no L2/L3 overheads were specified.

missing_inputs: Maximum non-AVB (lower-priority) frame size L_block to account for non-preemptive blocking; assumed no such traffic (L_block=0).
On-wire frame size (including L2 headers, VLAN tag, etc.). Payload bytes were treated as frame bytes.
Clarification on whether the 1 us time synchronization error should be added per hop or end-to-end for CBS (it does not affect CBS directly; thus not applied).

WCD_calculation.equation_used: For each hop (egress port): D_i,port = (T_port + sum_over_other_flows_on_that_port(sigma_j / R)) + sigma_i / (R - sum_over_all_flows_on_that_port(rho_k)). End-to-end WCD = sum_over_hops(D_i,port) + N_links * prop_delay + N_switches * switching_delay + N_switches * time_sync_error.
WCD_calculation.T_port_definition: T_port = L_A_max / I where L_A_max is the maximum AVB frame size (bits) among flows sharing that egress port, I = IdleSlope (bps).

variables.rho_i: flow i average rate (bps) = sigma_i / period_s

general_steps: Map each flow to egress ports from the provided routes; all use queue 6 (PCP 6).
Compute per-port Lmax from the set of flows using that egress port.
CBS parameters: C=12.5 B/us, I=9.375 B/us (75% of C), S=-3.125 B/us; hiCredit=0; loCredit=-(C-I)/C * Lmax.
Per-port CBS service curve: beta_p(t)=I*[t-T_p]^+ with T_p = ((C-I)/C)*(Lmax/I) = Lmax/37.5 us.
If a port is shared, derive per-flow leftover service: R' = I - Σrho_cross, T' = (I*T_p + Σsigma_cross)/(I - Σrho_cross). Else R'=I, T'=T_p.
Concatenate per-hop services: R_path = min R'_hop, T_path = Σ T'_hop.
Arrival curve per flow: alpha_i(t)=sigma_i + rho_i t with sigma_i=payload [B], rho_i=payload/period [B/us].
End-to-end delay bound: D_i = T_path + fixed_delays + sigma_i/(R_path - rho_i).
notes: All flows are AVB Class A (PCP 6) and the only shaped traffic; no other priorities are assumed present, so no NP blocking by lower-priority frames and no additional hiCredit from higher-priority interference.
Cut-through switching modeled as constant 1 us per switch; 2 switches per path.
Propagation is 1 us per link; 3 links per path.
Time synchronization error modeled as 1 us end-to-end additive.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curves: For each flow i: alpha_i(t) = b_i + r_i * t, with b_i = payload_bits, r_i = payload_bits / period_us [Mbps].
WCD_calculation.cbs_service_curve_per_port: For Class A at each egress port p with only CBS: beta_p(t) = I * [t - T_p]^+, with I = IdleSlope (75 Mbps) and T_p = Lmax_p / I, where Lmax_p is the maximum Class A frame size (in bits) among flows using port p. This T_p equals Lmax/C (non-preemptive blocking) + Lmax*(C - I)/(I*C) (credit recovery), which simplifies to Lmax/I.
WCD_calculation.leftover_service_for_flow_on_port: For flow i on port p under arbitrary multiplexing: R_i,p = I - sum_{j in X_p(i)} r_j; T_i,p = T_p + (sum_{j in X_p(i)} b_j) / I; where X_p(i) are the other flows sharing port p.
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_i,p = b_i / R_i,p + T_i,p  [µs when b in bits and rates in Mbps].
WCD_calculation.end_to_end: WCD_i = (sum over egress ports p on i's path of D_i,p) + N_switches*switching_delay + N_links*propagation_delay + time_sync_error.
WCD_calculation.explicit_equation_used: WCD_i = sum_p ( b_i / ( I - sum_{j≠i on p} r_j ) + Lmax_p / I + (sum_{j≠i on p} b_j)/I ) + (H-1)*1µs + H*1µs + 1µs, where H is hop_count (links), (H-1) is number of switches on the path.
